Definition: from G303 and the base of G5056; to (cause to) arise:--(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to rise, to spring up: God makes His sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust — and James says the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat than it withers the grass, and the flower thereof falls. It is used for the sun rising, for a plant springing up, and for the day dawning, and it appears nine times.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for rising carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the sun — rising on the evil and the good alike, and withering the grass by noon.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
